title: Introduce staged lint lanes and dependency-rotation CLI
author: Maya Chen
description: Context and motivation: Our full-lint and dependency-update pipeline has become a major contributor to PR feedback latency and noisy failures when transitive deps churn. This PR introduces two orthogonal changes aimed at improving developer feedback velocity and making dep updates observable and easy to triage: 1) staged lint lanes: a lightweight 'quick-lint' lane that runs on every push to give sub-2m feedback (fast checks, staged ESLint + python-flake8 subset, path-aware), and a deeper 'full-lint' lane that runs in pre-merge or nightly jobs; 2) dep-rotation CLI and CI integration: a small CLI (tools/dep-rotator) that performs bounded dependency rotation trials in an ephemeral job to detect incompatibilities earlier and produce a concise compatibility report. Design goals: reduce noisy failures on main CI, surface dep incompatibilities as targeted failures, remove unnecessary wall-clock time on common PRs, and provide an automated path to rotate minor/patch deps with safe gating. Summary of changes: added ci/actions/staged-lint.yml and ci/actions/quick-lint-composite action; added tools/dep-rotator (Go binary wrapper + integration tests); added a new presubmit job matrix that prefers quick-lint for small changes via path-filtering and schedules full-lint only for broad changes; introduced dep-rotation workflow ci/workflows/dep-rotation.yml which can be triggered manually, on schedule, or by linked Linear ticket; updated docs/developer/ci.md with rollout notes and opt-out flags; minor refactor of existing ci/scripts/run-lint.sh to make it composable. Checklist: implementation done; unit + integration tests added for dep-rotator; staging deploy of CI YAML validated in feature repo; reviewers: please validate job timeout and cache key behavior; rollout: staged rollout to 'fast-feedback' lane for 72 hours, monitor flaky-lint alerts and presubmit latency. Migration notes: no API or runtime breaking changes; teams that relied on always-running full-lint on push should update CI expectations or set the LINT_ALWAYS_FULL=true env in project config; containers caching keys unchanged except for quick-lint which uses a separate cache prefix. Metrics to watch post-merge: median presubmit latency, percentage of presubmits that short-circuit to quick-lint, dep-rotation report failures per week, flaky-lint alert rate. Related: ENG-4821 defined the fast-feedback SLA; ENG-4980 tracked dep-rotation requirements.

release_notes: - Introduces quick-lint presubmit lane to speed up common PR feedback; can be disabled per-project via LINT_ALWAYS_FULL=true. - Adds dep-rotator CLI and a scheduled/manual dep-rotation workflow to proactively detect dependency incompatibilities. - Refactors presubmit matrix to be path-aware reducing average CI wall time.
